- *(repositories)* Reconcile now becomes Align now — the dialog says the run changes the repository on GitHub and CircleCI to its declared set-up and the company baseline as the person; the dry run shows the manager's warning, the team's opt-in and the planned changes per step; Check now without the opt-in in [#2440](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2440) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
